setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): One of the longest Bird Songs ever, according to the reviewer; Extended Bird Song is a standout of the first set [13][14][17]
- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds it rhythmic, haunting and going to nice places; About 45 minutes long, with Bobby playing harmonics around the 22-minute mark [9][13][14]
- **Deal** (2 reviews): Keith's playing after the first instrumental break is highlighted; Bobby's playing and his interplay with Jerry on Deal are praised [17][18]
- **Promised Land** (1 review): Reviewer found it a letdown after Bird Song and suggests skipping to Deal [17]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Sugaree is another highlight for the reviewer [18]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): Described as lengthy and mysterious [10]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The He's Gone into Truckin' pairing is singled out as outstanding [10]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Described as tremendous [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-09-10.163863.sbd.miller.gems.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 216 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd72-09-10.sbd.patched.greenberg-powell.22793.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 198 min; rated 4.72/5 by 18 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording sounds great [12]
- **gd72-09-10.sbd.winters.17690.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 180 min; rated 4.31/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound is acceptable with few cuts; the Bertha intro is apparently missing; Recording is acceptable but not outstanding, rated three and a half stars; Soundboard is crisp yet warm, typical of early 1970s [7][9][10][14]
- **gd1972-09-10.sbd.lai.5679.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Notes list many pops, static, glitches and skips across discs, with steady clicking in D2T7 [4]
- **gd1972-09-10.sbd.vernon.5680.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Notes list many pops, static, glitches and skips across discs [5]

## Around the show

- David Crosby guests from the Dark Star segment through the end of the second set [7]
- David Crosby joins the band at Dark Star and stays until the show closes, with no encore [11]
- David Crosby sang and played guitar on Dark Star, Jack Straw, Sing Me Back Home and Sugar Magnolia [1]
- Highlights including the complete second set aired on KXCI Tucson in February 2023 and on KPFA in March 2023 [1]
- Dark Star, Jack Straw, Sing Me Back Home and Sugar Magnolia are marked as featuring a guest; the encore was One More Saturday Night [2]
- David Crosby plays guitar on the songs marked with an asterisk [4]
- David Crosby plays guitar on the songs marked with an asterisk [5]
- Follows an epic 8/27 show and precedes a second strong Hollywood show; fall energy recovered after uneven July shows following Pigpen's loss [8]
- Reviewer likens it to the 8-21 and 7-29 1972 shows [11]
- Dark Star ranked among the best the reviewer has heard, though not at the level of 3-1-69 [12]
- Jam heading toward The Other One before Jack Straw resembles the post-Truckin' jam and the Europe '72 Other One [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-09-10.163863.sbd.miller.gems.flac16**: transferred by Mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: Vault master SBD reel source (with assumed DAT generation) provided by Charlie Miller [1]. Also: Patched with a circulating soundboard source in Bird Song, Sugaree, Playing in the Band, Ramble On Rose and Dark Star [1]
- **gd72-09-10.sbd.patched.greenberg-powell.22793.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: This patched soundboard restores the last two songs and many cuts missing from the other source; Master-to-cassette-to-CD source patched with another cassette lineage; patches and remaster by Dave Greenberg [2][11]
- **gd72-09-10.sbd.winters.17690.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1972-09-10.sbd.lai.5679.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: SBD > [MR > C > DAT(s) ??] > CDR(s) > DAE > SHN [4]
- **gd1972-09-10.sbd.vernon.5680.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: SBD > [MR > C > DAT(s) ??] > CDR(s) > EAC > SHN > SHNTOOL (fix sector boundaries by sets) > mkwact (seekable) [5]. Also: Based on Mike Lai's original shn files, with fixed track boundaries and added seektables; uploaded to etree around October 2001 [5]
